design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (cargo_claims_desk, claims category, non-workflow task). Frozen 2026-09-14 15:20:00 CEST.

[1 Why this is a good test] The caller asks only to pay the premium of the CargoCare Premium cover he accepted for booking AHLU26HAM558902, believing the cover is set up. The records show the cover is still quoted, carries a preliminary insured value of 800000.00, and has no premium charged. The agent must read out of the policies that (a) a quoted cover is bound before its premium is charged or settled and that binding fixes the insured value from the transport document, (b) a remittance is taken only against premium already charged, and then compute three values in topological order: the insured value bound (857600.00 from the waybill's declared value pro rata to the 4 of 6 flat racks covered), the premium (2004.64: rate, out-of-gauge uplift, Key Account contract discount read across categories, minimum premium) and the balance the holder pays (2004.64, after reconciling remittances and refunds on this cover only). Every tool is a plain CRUD write; the difficulty is discovery and arithmetic.

[2 Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: claims_ext_settlement_invoice_share, claims_ext_notice_container_value, claims_ext_lodging_rejection_grounds, the workflow claims_wf_further_notice_on_open_cover and the tools approve/close/lodge/reject. Claimed here, disjoint: claims_ext_bind_invoice_value (bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc), claims_ext_premium_contract_rank (charge_cover_premium_8ce00127), claims_ext_premium_balance_remittance (pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f, owner user). charter_scope.workflows = []. After this task every declared extended policy is covered exactly once (3 + 3) and every task tool is used by exactly one task.

[3 Policies, lineage, triggers, overrides] claims_ext_bind_invoice_value: subject claims_cover_bound, base_policy_refs [claims_cover_eligibility], trigger on_request (the holder's acceptance), overwrite [] (base says the cover's insured value is the commercial invoice value and bounds it by min/max; E4 fixes it at binding from the transport document recorded for the holder and, since round 2, keeps base's min/max as a refusal: a value outside the band is not bound and nothing is substituted). claims_ext_premium_contract_rank: subject claims_premium_charged, refs [claims_premium], trigger state_due (a bound cover owes its premium), overwrite [] - it restates the base build-up and pins what base leaves implicit: the uplift acts on the base premium, the discount on the uplifted premium (successive, never combined), the minimum after both, rounding only at the end, the contract read is the holder's active contract on any lane and the rank ladder Starter 1 ... Strategic Partner 6. claims_ext_premium_balance_remittance: subject claims_premium_paid, refs [claims_premium], trigger on_request, overwrite [] - governs premiums settled after binding (the cash_in_advance prepaid case of claims_cover_eligibility is outside it); premium owed = the product premium on the bound insured value on the bound_date, else the sum of charges on the cover; balance = premium owed less remittances and refunds, never below 0.00 and never above premium_due_usd; 'a reference is recorded once per cover' inherited. Cross-category numeric reads: bol declared_cargo_value_usd and booking container_count (binding), contract variant_name of the active contract (premium and balance); all are seeded for this customer.

[4 Forward and reverse basis sweep] Bind: invoice_value <- 'multiplied by the containers the cover takes (the cover's container_count) and divided by the booking's container_count, the result rounded to the cent. When the transport document carries no declared cargo value, the insured value on the quote is kept.'; result <- 'a cover whose value so fixed is below the minimum or above the maximum is not bound at all, and no other value is substituted for it' (no cap binding exists since round 2). Premium: base_premium, gross_premium, net_premium, minimum_premium, result each quote their ordered sentence ('First ...', 'Then ...', 'The uplift and the discount act one after the other, each on the result of the step before, never combined into one rate.', 'only this final figure is rounded to the cent'); contract_tier <- 'the contract read is the holder's contract in the active status on any trade lane'. Balance: product_premium quotes the whole parenthesised build-up; on_bound_date/premium_owed <- 'On the cover's bound_date the premium owed is the premium the cover's product yields' and 'on any later date the premium owed is the sum of the premium charges booked on the cover'; remitted/refunded <- 'less the amounts of every premium remittance already applied to the cover and of every premium refund already booked on it'; result <- 'never below 0.00' and 'it never exceeds the premium_due_usd the cover's account shows'. Reverse: every rule sentence with a quantity, branch, order, cap or rounding is claimed by a binding; the binding-deadline and prepayment sentence of the bind rule restates inherited base gates (solvability, not compute).

[5 Base-invariant card] Bind (claims_cover_bound, claims_cover_eligibility): bind_before_departure - anchor bookings.etd_date 2026-09-17, duration variants.bind_deadline_days_before_etd = 2 for Premium, deadline 2026-09-15 inclusive; 2026-09-14 is in time; 2026-09-15 would be the last allowed day and 2026-09-16 refused. prepaid_premium - credit_status credit_approved, so the prepayment condition (cash_in_advance and prepayment required - Premium has premium_prepayment_required false anyway) does not apply. no_credit_hold - credit_approved. The quote-time gates (document_drafted: waybill draft 2026-09-10; forwarder_allowed: beneficial_cargo_owner; one_cover_per_booking: the only cover on the booking) were met when the quote was made and still hold. Charge (claims_premium): premium_on_active - active after the binding (prior step 8); premium_once - the only claims_premium_charged row on the account belongs to the expired 2025 cover. Pay (claims_premium): remittance_once - reference KRG-PR-58316 appears only on the 2025 cover's payment row, so it is recorded once on this cover; 2004.64 does not exceed premium_due 2004.64.

[6 Business-object card] Target: cover of booking AHLU26HAM558902 (quoted, 4 x 40FR of 6). Included: the waybill AHLU2609551473 (declared 1286400.00) of the same booking, the booking's container_count 6, the holder's active AHL Key Account Contract. Excluded: the expired 2025 CargoCare Plus cover on booking AHLU25HAM536417 and its premium 432.00 / payment 432.00 (other cover_id - a customer-level reconciliation would wrongly subtract 432.00 and ask for 1572.64), its waybill (240000.00) and booking. The cross-category reads are the holder's own records (waybill, booking, contract all under customer f28c...), as the round-2 rules state.

[7 Problem-tree card] Root: claims_ext_premium_balance_remittance (the payment the caller asked for). Edge A (state_gate, gate claims_premium.remittance_once since round 2): root <- claims_ext_premium_contract_rank, policy_source 'A remittance is taken only against premium already charged to the cover, so a bound cover whose premium has not yet been charged has it charged before the holder pays.'; false at frozen_time: premium_due_usd 0.00, status quoted, no ledger row on the cover. Edge B (value_input since round 3, gate premium_owed): root <- claims_ext_bind_invoice_value, policy_source 'The balance is worked out on a bound cover, so, outside the prepaid case, a quoted cover is bound before its premium is settled.'; false: status quoted, insured 800000.00, bound_date empty. Edge C (value_input, gate insured): claims_ext_premium_contract_rank <- claims_ext_bind_invoice_value, policy_source 'The premium is worked out on the insured value fixed when the cover is bound, so a quoted cover is bound before its premium is charged'. Topological order: bind -> charge -> pay (unique, since the root's two prerequisites are themselves ordered by edge C). Sensitivity (verify.py 1): skip the charge -> balance still 2004.64 but no premium row and premium_due ends -2004.64 (hash differs); skip the binding -> the premium recomputes 1870.00 (800000.00 x 0.25% x 1.10 x 0.85; value_input edge C) and the cover stays quoted with no bound_date (state gate B). user_scenario never names binding, the insured value, a charge or a policy id; tools validate nothing (pay can drive premium_due negative, charge books on a quoted cover).

[8 World rows and why each exists] customers (1): credentials AHL-DE-583114 / +49405518207, credit_approved (no prepayment, no credit hold). service_contracts (1): AHL Key Account Contract, active, asia_north_europe - rank 4 gives the 15% discount although the shipment is transatlantic (trap: an agent restricting the discount to the booking's lane or to the booking's rating contract - the booking is spot, contract_id null - would charge 2358.40); remove it and the premium is 2358.40. bookings (2): the target AHLU26HAM558902 (6 x 40FR, etd 2026-09-17, deadline 2026-09-15) whose container_count divides the invoice value, and the closed 2025 booking behind the old cover. bills_of_lading (2): the target draft (declared 1286400.00; without it the bind falls back to 800000.00) and the 2025 waybill. cargo_covers (2): the quoted target (insured 800000.00 estimate, 4 containers, out_of_gauge) and the expired 2025 Plus cover. claims_ledger (2): the 2025 premium 432.00 and its payment with the standing reference KRG-PR-58316 - load-bearing as the cover-scoping trap and as the evidence that the reference is new on this cover. No automatic clause fires: the old cover is already expired; the quote does not lapse before its deadline; no cache is stale.

[9 Persona design] Tobias Wernicke-Aldag: brisk, friendly, repeats that the ship sails Thursday. Volunteers the goal (pay the premium today), the circumstance (accepted the quote by email, finance wants it paid before sailing) and a hard preference (he pays himself with reference KRG-PR-58316, his standing reference). On request: customer code, then phone, then tax number; four of six racks covered, invoice on the bill of lading draft; a Key Account contract for the Asia business. Passive reactions: agrees if told the cover must first be put in force; accepts a different insured value if it matches the invoice; pays the amount the agent states; ends when told the payment is booked and nothing more is owed - which answers the last gold action. He does not remember or guess the premium, and never states a method.

[10 Reachability] Every argument is reachable: ids from finder returns; 857600.00 and 2004.64 from the published rules and the records; KRG-PR-58316 from the caller; the payment is a user-owned step handed over by the agent and run in the same turn. Nothing waits on a real-world event: binding and charging are the line's own bookings, the payment is the holder's own act in this call.

[11 Where a careless agent goes wrong] Paying before any premium is charged (the payment then leaves a credit); charging before binding (premium on a quoted cover) or binding at the quoted 800000.00 (1870.00); forgetting that the cover takes 4 of 6 racks (1286400.00 x 0.25% ... = 3006.96); applying uplift and discount as one combined rate (2144.00 x (1 + 0.10 - 0.15) = 2036.80); dropping the discount because the contract is on another lane (2358.40); subtracting the 2025 cover's 432.00 remittance (1572.64); refusing the reference because it was used before (it is per cover); leaving the charge unbooked and letting the payment create a credit.

[12 Standard solution] find_customers(AHL-DE-583114) -> verify_customer_identity(customer code, phone) -> find_bookings(customer) -> find_cargo_covers(customer) -> find_claims_ledger(customer) -> find_bills_of_lading(customer) -> find_service_contracts(customer) -> bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc(cover, booking, customer, 857600.00) -> charge_cover_premium_8ce00127(cover, 2004.64) -> [caller] pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f(cover, 2004.64, KRG-PR-58316). Closure: computations = scope = required_documents = the three policies in that order; task_tools = the three tools in first-call order; no workflow tool used.

[13 Verification actually executed] verify.py 1 (verify.py was a temporary authoring script, removed after use; the same handling-time recompute and value_input skip test are re-runnable with: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/global_container_shipping_line/tasks/cargo_claims_desk --task N): 'RECOMPUTE claims_ext_bind_invoice_value step 8 -> 857600.0 | expected 857600.0'; 'RECOMPUTE claims_ext_premium_contract_rank step 10 -> 2004.64 | expected 2004.64'; 'RECOMPUTE claims_ext_premium_balance_remittance step 12 -> 2004.64 | expected 2004.64'; 'SKIP ...remittance <- ...contract_rank skipped [10] | balance 2004.64 | terminal hash differs: True'; 'SKIP ...remittance <- ...bind_invoice_value skipped [8] | premium 1870.0, balance 2004.64 (later-date branch) | differs: True' (round 2 re-run); 'SKIP ...contract_rank <- ...bind_invoice_value skipped [8] | premium 1870.0 | differs: True'. Gates run green with --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 10 = init 10), SOLVABILITY OK (6 base gates), COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[14 Solvability vs GT and a visible-context draft recompute] Base preconditions cite pre-action rows correlated by booking_id, customer_id, cover_id and payment_reference (the charge step cites prior step 8 for the active status). Draft from what a rollout sees: the payment rule says premium must be charged and the cover bound first -> the cover is quoted -> bind rule: 1286400.00 x 4 / 6 = 857600.00 (< 2500000.00) -> premium rule: 857600.00 x 0.25% = 2144.00, x1.10 = 2358.40, Key Account rank 4 >= 3 -> x0.85 = 2004.64, minimum 200.00 -> balance rule: 2004.64 - 0 - 0 = 2004.64 -> caller pays with KRG-PR-58316. Same as gold; no second reading found.

[15 Manual values gates] Long: request -> payment rule -> charge prerequisite -> binding prerequisite -> invoice value -> premium build-up -> balance. Broad: tier parameters, waybill, booking, contract tier, cover-scoped ledger, deadline. The user step is the holder's own payment. Chronology: the acceptance email and belief the cover is set up are caller statements; the system record (quoted) is authoritative and the persona does not contradict it. Revision log: (r1) the first draft had no claims_ledger row, which left the prepaid_premium / premium_once / remittance_once evidence without a ledger field -> added the customer's expired 2025 cover with its premium and payment (standing reference), reads switched to customer-level finders so the closure matches; (r2) the persona gained the line that KRG-PR-58316 is the standing reference; all gates re-run green.

[Difficulty-level closing record] Tasks 0 and 1 together claim all six extended policies, pairwise disjoint; one workflow, claimed by task 0 only; seven task tools, each used by exactly one task; no handoff in any gold.

[Round 2 rework - audit policy_task/cargo_claims_desk] F-1: E6 now states it governs premiums settled after binding and puts the claims_cover_eligibility prepaid case (cash_in_advance + premium_prepayment_required) outside itself; E4 keeps re-affirming the prepayment gate, so the two no longer prescribe opposite orders; this holder is credit_approved on a no-prepayment product. F-4: E4's cap at max_cover_value_usd removed; a value outside min/max is not bound (base gate kept); compute now ends at the invoice value (5 bindings). F-5: E6 no longer recomputes the premium at an arbitrary date: on the bound_date the owed premium is the build-up (the charge of that day uses the same records), later it is the sum of charges, so the balance never exceeds premium_due_usd; the rule says so. O-1: E4 reads the waybill and booking 'recorded for the cover holder' and names the fallback for a missing booking count (O-14 analogue). O-6: cargo bindings got compute_basis entries. O-8/O-T1-2: E6 -> E5 gate is claims_premium.remittance_once. O-10: E5 -> E4 condition now says 'fixed at binding under the insured-value rule for binding'. O-T1-1: persona no longer points at the invoice basis ('the paperwork for the shipment is with the line already'; 'that is fine'). O-T1-3: customer-level finders kept deliberately (they surface the 2025 distractor cover). O-5: one active contract in this world; the rule's reading of the holder's active contract is unchanged. Consequences: E6 -> E4 edge re-typed state_gate (skipping the bind no longer moves the balance, only the terminal state); the tree keeps its value_input edge E5 -> E4. Gates re-run green after the change (see the difficulty-level run).

[Round 3 rework - audit revision_2] F-1 (extended side): E4 no longer re-affirms the prepayment gate; it now states that a cover whose premium claims_cover_eligibility requires to be received before binding (cash_in_advance holder, premium_prepayment_required true) is outside E4 and outside the charge and settlement policies that follow binding, and keeps the other binding gates (deadline, credit_hold). E5 gained the same scope sentence; E6 already had it. No extended policy now legislates an order for the prepaid combination, so none leaves a situation inside its own scope without a valid order; the base-internal loop is the coordinator-logged blueprint issue. This holder is credit_approved on a no-prepayment product, so every value is unchanged. R2-O2: E6 now says a cover never bound (no bound_date) owes no premium (premium_owed 0.00), so the E6 -> E4 edge is a real value_input on the compute binding premium_owed (skip the bind -> balance 0.00 instead of 2004.64, verified by the private scratch recompute and check_compute) instead of a state_gate naming a field. R2-O3: the unimplemented sentence 'it never exceeds the premium_due_usd the cover's account shows' was removed; the base limit 'may not exceed premium_due_usd' stays inherited through claims_premium.remittance_once in the solvability contract, and E6's own branches (the build-up the same-day charge used; the sum of charges on later dates) are what the compute implements. O-5, O-T1-3 kept (one active contract here; customer-level finders surface the 2025 distractor). Re-run: bind 857600.00, charge 2004.64, pay 2004.64 unchanged; skip charge -> 2004.64 with premium_due -2004.64 (state gate); skip bind -> charge 1870.00, balance 0.00.

[Round 4 rework - KB render report] The E6 -> E4 prerequisite condition carried the field name bound_date, which the renderer could only reproduce as 'bound_ date'. Reworded at the source to 'The quoted cover has been bound, so it carries a binding date and the insured value fixed at binding.' (claims.extended.yaml E6 prerequisite and this task's prerequisite_closure edge); kind, gate (premium_owed), policy_source and every value unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Tobias Wernicke-Aldag, who runs export logistics at Kaltenbach Rotorguss GmbH, a Hamburg foundry that ships steel turbine housing castings. You are friendly but brisk, you talk quickly, and you mention more than once that the vessel sails on Thursday. You open by saying that last week you received the line's CargoCare Premium quote for your castings on booking AHLU26HAM558902, that you emailed back accepting it, and that your finance team wants the cargo protection paid before the ship sails, so you would like to pay the premium today while you are on the phone. As far as you know everything about the cover is already set up. You pay the premium yourself from the company account when the agent gives you the payment step, and you quote your own payment reference exactly as KRG-PR-58316, the standing reference your finance team puts on every payment to the line. You are happy for the agent to do whatever else on the account is needed to get the premium right. You do not remember the premium figure on the quote and you do not guess one; you pay the amount the agent tells you is due. When the agent asks how to find your account, you give your customer code, AHL-DE-583114. When asked for a second detail you give your registered phone number, +49405518207, and only if one more is needed you give your tax registration number, DE815425573. Only if the agent asks about the shipment do you explain that it is six flat racks of out-of-gauge castings, that your cover takes four of them because the buyer insures the other two itself, and that the paperwork for the shipment is with the line already. Only if the agent asks whether you have a contract with the line do you say that you have a Key Account contract with Aurelia Hanse Line, although it is for your Asia to North Europe business, not this Houston shipment. If the agent tells you the cover is not yet in force and still has to be put in force first, you say you had thought your email took care of that and that yes, it must be in force before the sailing, so the agent should go ahead. If the agent tells you the insured value will be different from the figure on the quote, you say that is fine. When the agent tells you the premium amount due, you accept it and make the payment with your reference. Once the agent confirms the payment is booked and nothing more is owed on the cover, you thank the agent and end the call. You never tell the agent how a premium or an insured value should be worked out.

request_alignment.claim: The caller wants to pay, today, the premium of the CargoCare Premium cover he accepted for booking AHLU26HAM558902, himself, with his own payment reference.
evidence: user_scenario:you would like to pay the premium today while you are on the phone
user_scenario:you quote your own payment reference exactly as KRG-PR-58316

gold_actions.business_effect: Binds the quoted AHL CargoCare Premium cover: status quoted -> active, bound_date 2026-09-14, insured_value_usd 800000.00 (quote estimate) -> 857600.00 (invoice value of the four flat racks covered).

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller accepted the CargoCare Premium quote and wants the cover's premium paid before the sailing; the cover is still quoted, and a quoted cover is bound before its premium is charged or settled, so the binding (not a new quote, which one_cover_per_booking forbids while this quote is in force) is the action.

stage_provenance.fact: The cover attaches to the shipment on this binding; the quote, the drafted transport document and the confirmed booking already exist.

gold_actions.zero_wait_proof: Binding is a synchronous change of the line's cover record at frozen_time: the quote (initial_state cargo_covers status quoted), the drafted document (bills_of_lading status draft), the etd 2026-09-17 and the holder's acceptance (current_user_input) are all present; no payment is needed first because the holder is credit_approved.

base_preconditions.condition: A cover must be bound no later than the tier's bind_deadline_days_before_etd calendar days before the scheduled departure date.
When the cover holder's credit_status is cash_in_advance and the product's premium_prepayment_required is true, the premium must be received before binding.
base_preconditions.note: The holder is credit_approved, so prepayment before binding does not apply.

base_preconditions.condition: A cover holder on credit_hold cannot bind a CargoCare product.

gold_actions.business_effect: Books the premium charge of 2004.64 on the bound cover and raises premium_due_usd from 0.00 to 2004.64.

request_binding.action_semantics: A bound cover is charged premium once at binding; the cover bound at step 8 has no premium entry, so the charge is owed and must precede any payment of the premium.

discriminator.business_meaning: premium charge owed by the cover just bound

stage_provenance.fact: The cover became active at the binding of step 8.

gold_actions.zero_wait_proof: The charge is a booking on the line's own account at frozen_time; its only stage fact, the active cover with its bound insured value, was produced synchronously by step 8.

base_preconditions.condition: A premium may be booked only on a cover whose status is active.
A cover is charged premium once.
base_preconditions.note: The only premium charge on the account belongs to the expired 2025 cover.

gold_actions.business_effect: The cover holder pays 2004.64 with reference KRG-PR-58316; premium_due_usd on the cover goes from 2004.64 to 0.00.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller wants to pay the premium today himself; paying is the cover holder's own act, so it is the user-owned payment write, for the full balance owed.

evidence: user_scenario:you would like to pay the premium today while you are on the phone
user_scenario:you would like to pay the premium today while you are on the phone

stage_provenance.fact: Premium 2004.64 was charged to the cover at step 10.

gold_actions.zero_wait_proof: The holder pays in this turn through the payment step handed over by the agent; the premium it settles was charged synchronously at step 10; no bank clearing or later event is relied on.

base_preconditions.condition: A premium remittance is written with the reference exactly as quoted, may not exceed premium_due_usd, and a reference is recorded once per cover.
base_preconditions.note: The reference is recorded once per cover: it appears only on the expired 2025 cover, so recording it on this cover is its first use here; the amount does not exceed premium_due_usd 2004.64.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A cover must be bound no later than the tier's bind_deadline_days_before_etd calendar days before the scheduled departure date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The binding deadline is the booking's etd_date minus the tier's deadline days counted on calendar dates, and binding on the deadline date itself is allowed.

boundary_check.just_before: Binding deadline = etd 2026-09-17 minus bind_deadline_days_before_etd 2 = 2026-09-15; binding on 2026-09-15 is still allowed (inclusive).
boundary_check.at_boundary: Binding on 2026-09-16 or later would be refused; frozen_time 2026-09-14 is one day before the last allowed date, so the binding is in time.

seed_consistency.check: Quoted AHL CargoCare Premium on out_of_gauge cargo (eligible), 4 of 6 containers (partial cover allowed for Premium), quote estimate 800000.00 within 10000.00-2500000.00, unbound (bound_date empty), no premium booked (premium_due 0.00 equals no ledger entry), one cover in force on the booking, transport document drafted 2026-09-10.

2025 AHL CargoCare Plus on general cargo, bound 2025-07-02 before the 2025-07-07 deadline (etd 2025-07-08 minus 1), delivered 2025-08-20 and expired after the 12-month time bar 2026-08-20 with no open claim; premium 432.00 charged and paid, premium_due 0.00.
240000.00 x 0.18% = 432.00, general cargo (no uplift), the holder had no active contract in July 2025 (the Key Account contract took effect 2026-01-01), above the 70.00 minimum.
Remittance 432.00 with the holder's standing reference KRG-PR-58316, referencing the premium row, not above premium_due; recorded once on that cover.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the Kaltenbach Rotorguss GmbH profile from the customer code the caller states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer reference; the profile supplies the credit status (credit_approved) and the credentials.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller with customer code and phone number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account business before identity is confirmed; the binding and premium act on this customer's cover.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the caller's bookings and pick AHLU26HAM558902, the number he quoted: confirmed, 6 x 40FR out-of-gauge, etd 2026-09-17 (the other booking, AHLU25HAM536417, is the closed 2025 shipment).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the booking id, the etd for the binding deadline (2026-09-15 for a 2-day tier) and the booking's container_count 6, the divisor of the bound insured value.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the caller's covers: the AHL CargoCare Premium cover on booking AHLU26HAM558902 (status quoted, insured_value_usd 800000.00, container_count 4, out_of_gauge, premium_due 0.00) and an expired 2025 AHL CargoCare Plus cover on booking AHLU25HAM536417.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Reveals that the cover the caller believes is in force is still only quoted (the binding prerequisite), and supplies tier, cargo type and containers for the premium.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the caller's claims account: only the expired 2025 cover's premium 432.00 and its payment with reference KRG-PR-58316; nothing on the new cover.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows no premium has been charged, remitted or refunded on the new cover (so the charge is still owed and the balance is the full premium), and that the caller's standing reference KRG-PR-58316 was recorded only on the other cover, so it may be recorded once on this one.

edges.policy_source: A remittance is taken only against premium already charged to the cover, so a bound cover whose premium has not yet been charged has it charged before the holder pays.

edges.condition: The quoted cover has been bound, so it carries a binding date and the insured value fixed at binding.

edges.condition: The cover is active and its insured value has been fixed at binding under the insured-value rule for binding before the premium is built up.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The root's two prerequisites are themselves ordered: the premium charge depends on the binding (claims_ext_premium_contract_rank: 'The premium is worked out on the insured value fixed when the cover is bound, so a quoted cover is bound before its premium is charged'; base claims_premium: 'A premium may be booked only on a cover whose status is active.'), and the payment depends on both (claims_ext_premium_balance_remittance: 'A remittance is taken only against premium already charged to the cover' and 'The balance is worked out on a bound cover, so, outside the prepaid case, a quoted cover is bound before its premium is settled.'). The holder is credit_approved, so the prepaid case of claims_cover_eligibility (pay before binding) is outside the tree. Only the order bind -> charge -> pay satisfies every edge, so no parallel reordering exists.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the premium charge (step 10): the balance still recomputes 2004.64 (on the bound date it is the product premium), but the terminal DB has no claims_premium_charged entry and the payment drives premium_due_usd to -2004.64, beyond what claims_premium.remittance_once allows (it may not exceed premium_due_usd, 0.00 before the charge). State gate; hash differs.

Skipping the binding (step 8) and replaying the rest unchanged: the cover stays quoted with no bound_date, so premium_owed is 0.00 and the balance recomputes 0.00 instead of 2004.64 (value_input since round 3, machine-checked by check_compute); the charge also lands on a quoted cover and the terminal DB differs.

Skipping the binding (step 8): the premium's insured binding stays 800000.00 and the premium recomputes 1870.00 instead of 2004.64 (value_input, machine-checked by check_compute), and the charge lands on a cover that is still quoted.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to pay the premium today and says the caller believes the cover is already set up. It never mentions binding, putting the cover in force, the insured value to be fixed, a premium charge or any policy id; the lines about the cover not being in force and a different insured value are passive reactions that fire only after the agent has said so.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: task_tools.py checks no prerequisite: pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f books the payment and lowers premium_due_usd whatever the cover's status or balance (it can go negative); charge_cover_premium_8ce00127 books a premium on a quoted cover as readily as on an active one; bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc writes the status, date and value without reading the deadline, credit status or document. A skipped prerequisite shows only in the terminal DB.
